# opnsense_unbound_dnsbl (Data Source)

Unbound DNS blocklist policies.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the blocklist policy.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address returned for blocked names.
- `allowlists` (Set of String) Domains that are never blocked.
- `blocklists` (Set of String) Domains that are always blocked.
- `cache_ttl` (Number) How long downloaded lists are cached, in seconds.
- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this policy is enabled.
- `lists` (Set of String) URLs of additional blocklists.
- `nxdomain` (Boolean) Whether blocked names are answered with NXDOMAIN.
- `source_nets` (Set of String) Client networks this policy applies to.
- `type` (Set of String) Predefined blocklists by OPNsense key.
- `wildcards` (Set of String) Domains blocked together with all their subdomains.
